SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. Q. D.. 751..
Date ..29...12...29.

December 28, 9

Dear Colonel,

JOSEPH J. COR ZEBROVSKY.

Further to my letter of December 18 on the
above subject, Zebrovsky alias Jebrovsky, who is
identical with Brin, Jenior, arrived in Canton from
Vladivostock in the latter part of 1926, and was
accompanied by two of his sons. Shortly afterwards
Brin was appointed military and political adviser to
General Tang Cheng Chih, and his sons were engaged
as military instructors in the Koumintang army. It
was considered in Soviet circles that Comrade Zebrovsky
alias Brin, who is a member of the Comintern, would be
appointed successor to Borodin in China, but he failed
to secure the position in consequence of a breach which
occurred between the Koumintang and its Soviet allies
in 1927.

The sons of Zebrovsky alias Jebrovsky passed
through Shanghai on July II, 1929 on the s.s. "Mondago"
en route from Canton to Vladivostock.

As requested I enclose herewith two extra
copies of the photographs of Zebrovsky.

Yours sincerely,

Scar

Lieut. Col. G.H.R. Halland, O.B.E.,

Photos enclosed.
O. A.

编号 I. Q. D.. 751..
日期 ..29...12...29.

12月28日，9

亲爱的上校：

约瑟夫·J·科尔·泽布罗夫斯基（JOSEPH J. COR ZEBROVSKY）。

继我12月18日关于上述主题的信件之后，经查，泽布罗夫斯基（又名杰布罗夫斯基），即布林（Brin）、杰尼奥尔（Jenior），于1926年下半年从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达广州，并由其两个儿子陪同。不久后，布林被任命为唐生智将军的军事和政治顾问，其儿子们则受聘为国民党军队的军事教官。在苏联圈子里，人们认为作为共产国际成员的泽布罗夫斯基同志（又名布林）将被任命为鲍罗廷在中国的继任者，但由于1927年国民党与其苏联盟友之间发生破裂，他未能获得该职位。

泽布罗夫斯基（又名杰布罗夫斯基）的儿子们于1929年7月11日乘坐“蒙达戈”号（s.s. "Mondago"）轮船途经上海，从广州前往符拉迪沃斯托克。

按照要求，随函附上泽布罗夫斯基照片的额外副本两份。

此致，

斯卡尔（Scar）

G.H.R. 哈兰中校（Lieut. Col. G.H.R. Halland），O.B.E.勋衔，

附照片。
O. A.

Subject (in full) Joseph Jacob Zebrovsky, alias Jebrovsky
Made by D.S. Ovsiannikoff. Forwarded by Tho Robertson C.I.D.

Sir,
With reference to the attached letter from Lieut
Colonel G.H.R. Holland, dated December 21, 1929, inquiries
□□ to show that Comrade Joseph Jacob Zebrovsky alias
Jebrovsky, who is identical with Brin, the elder, arrived
in Canton from Vladivostok together with his 2 sons at
the end of 1926 and shortly afterwards was appointed
military □nd political adviser to General Tang Sheng
Chih, while his sons were appointed military instructors
in General Tang Sheng Chih's Army. Comrade Zebrovsky
□lies Brin, who is a member of Comintern, was considered
by Soviet circles as a possible successor to Borodin in
China. The fact that Soviet Advisers were dismissed by
General Chiang Kai Shek prevented this and he left Hankow
for U.S.S.R. in Borodin's party. His sons left Canton
in the s.s. "Mondeno" for Vladivostok via Shanghai leaving
the latter port on July 11, 1929.
V. Ovsiannikoff
D. S.

（批：A/C.
24 12/29）

A/D. C. I.
（批：Reg. Please draft reply to Colonel Holland,
letter forwarding above information and
photographs!
24/12/29）

主题（全称） 约瑟夫·雅各布·泽布罗夫斯基，又名杰布罗夫斯基
由 D.S. 奥夫相尼科夫（Ovsiannikoff）撰写。由 Tho Robertson 刑事调查处转发。

先生，
关于附件中 G.H.R. 霍兰（Holland）中校于1929年12月21日发出的信件，调查□□显示，约瑟夫·雅各布·泽布罗夫斯基同志（又名杰布罗夫斯基），即老布林（Brin, the elder），于1926年底与他的两个儿子一起从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达广州，不久后被任命为唐生智将军的军事□nd政治顾问，而他的儿子们则被任命为唐生智将军军队中的军事教官。泽布罗夫斯基同志（又名布林）是共产国际成员，被苏联圈子视为鲍罗廷在中国的可能继任者。蒋介石将军解雇苏联顾问的事实阻止了这一点，他随鲍罗廷一行离开汉口前往苏联。他的儿子们乘坐“蒙代诺”号（s.s. "Mondeno"）轮船离开广州，经上海前往符拉迪沃斯托克，于1929年7月11日离开后者港口。
V. 奥夫相尼科夫
D. S.

（批：A/C.
24 12/29）

A/D. C. I.
（批：登记室。请起草回复霍兰上校的信件，转交上述信息和照片！
24/12/29）

H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai,
21, December 1929.

My dear Alers,

Many thanks for your letter No.D751 of the 18th December,
1929, with which you kindly sent me some particulars of the photograph
of Comrade Joseph Jacob Zebrovsky, alias Jebrovsky. The photograph
makes it clear that this man is identical with the Soviet Agent who
was in Hankow in 1927 under the name of Brin, the elder, and who appeared
in a group photograph taken at Hankow in that year with General Tang
Sheng Chih and others. Would you very kindly let me have two more
copies of Zebrovsky's photograph and also any information of interest
which you may have about Brin the elder.

Yours sincerely,
C.H.K. Hallet.

December 18,

Dear Colonel,

JOSEPH JACOB ZEBROVSKY

With reference to your letter of December 10,
enquiries show that Comrade J.J. Zebrovsky alias
Jebrovsky, former military adviser to General Tang
Sheng Chih, departed from Hankow in Borodin's party
for the U.S.S.R. at the end of 1927, since when
nothing further has been heard about him. I attach
herewith a photograph of Zebrovsky, which was taken
during his sojourn in China.

Yours sincerely,

Lieut. Col. G.H.R. Halland, O.B.E.,

Photograph enclosed.
O. A.
19. 12. 29.

见 D. 751.
J.-1. 杰布罗维奇（JEBROVITCH）。

一名俄国犹太人。汉口唐生智将军的军事顾问。据报是第三国际的著名成员，并渴望接替鲍罗廷成为苏联在华首席代表。有两个儿子在唐生智部队中担任教官。

pages.en:
Extract from SUSPECT LIST NO.1 dated 19.5.27 (File No.I.O.7922)
------------------------

J.-1. JEROVITCH.

A Russian Jew. Military adviser to General Tang
Sheng Chih at Hankow. Reported to be a prominent member
of the Third International and to have aspirations of
succeeding Borodin as the Chief Soviet representative in China.
Has two sons who are serving as instructors with Tang Sheng
Chih's troops.

J.-1. 杰罗维奇（JEROVITCH）。

一名俄国犹太人。汉口唐生智将军的军事顾问。据报是第三国际的著名成员，并渴望接替鲍罗廷成为苏联在华首席代表。有两个儿子在唐生智部队中担任教官。

Shanghai Municipal Police.
4540
8/5/27
Intelligence Office Station.
April 27, 1927.
REPORT ON Comrade Jebrovitch
Made by P.C.S.Kedrolivansky Forwarded by [签名] B. S. Q.
Sir,
I beg to forward herewith three different
pictures containing a photograph of a Russian named Jebrovitch,
a Russian Jew, who is a military advisor to General Tang
Sung Tse (唐生智).
Jebrovitch is prominent member of the 3rd
International and aspires to succeed Borodin as the
representative of that body in China. Jebrovitch has two
sons who also serve as instructors under Gen. Tang Sung
Tse.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[签名]
P. C. S.
D.C.I.
[签名]
[签名]

关于杰布罗维奇同志的报告
由 P.C.S. 凯德罗利万斯基（Kedrolivansky）撰写，由 [签名] B. S. Q. 转发。
先生，
谨此呈送三张不同的图片，其中包含一名名为杰布罗维奇（Jebrovitch）的俄国人的照片，他是一名俄国犹太人，是唐生智（Tang Sung Tse）将军的军事顾问。
杰布罗维奇是第三国际的著名成员，并渴望接替鲍罗廷成为该机构在华代表。杰布罗维奇有两个儿子，也在唐生智将军麾下担任教官。
先生，我是
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
P. C. S.
D.C.I.
[签名]
